title: The Multi-Slit Hodge Compiler: Algorithmic Algebraic Cycle Extraction via N-Slit Grating Sifting and Inductive Lefschetz Hyperplane Slicing
description: Formal machine-verified Lean 4 proof and numerical probe establishing the Multi-Slit Hodge Compiler using N-slit grating sifting, Sorkin 3-slit null cancellation, and Lefschetz hyperplane induction. In this work, ai is being used as a tool to assist in formal verification, symbol auditing, and manuscript preparation.
